Specifies files and directories to ignore in Docker builds, including the `.venv` directory.

# Purpose
The `.venv` file is used to indicate the presence of a Python virtual environment in the directory. It serves as a marker for tools and scripts to recognize and activate the virtual environment, which isolates dependencies and packages for a specific project. This helps to manage and maintain project-specific dependencies without affecting the global Python environment.
